tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Venues covered (Polymarket, Kalshi, PredictIt, Manifold), the number of open markets on each, sync health and whether prices are streamed live.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Open binary markets on every venue whose text contains all the keywords, with normalised prices (probability, best bid and ask for YES and NO), volume, close time, the venue URL and the cross-venue eventId when the market is matched on other venues.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Full detail for one market by id: {venue}:{nativeId}, as returned by search_markets.

tools.name: find_cross_venue_events
tools.description: Propositions matched across venues with each venue's price side by side, the liquidity-weighted consensus probability, the dispersion between venues and the cheapest venue to buy YES or NO.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One matched event by id (evt_...), with every venue quote and the live arbitrage and mispricing signals on it.

tools.name: find_arbitrage
tools.description: Cross-venue arbitrage, buying YES on one venue and NO on another so one leg always pays, with net edge per contract after modelled fees, ROI and available size. tools.name: find_mispricings
tools.description: Venues whose executable price is away from the consensus of the other real-money venues, with expected edge per contract if that consensus is right. Without a PRO plan, results beyond a short preview cost $0.01 per call from the caller's prepaid credit; callers without credit see the preview.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Implied probability of one market as the last value per bucket, for any range (default the last 24 hours at 5 minute resolution). tools.name: post_signal
tools.description: Records a forecast on one market (or cross-venue event) for the calling API key. probability is the probability that the market resolves YES. tools.name: list_my_signals
tools.description: The calling key's signals, newest first, with status (OPEN, SCORED, VOID) and scores once resolved.

tools.name: get_calibration
tools.description: The calling key's calibration record - Brier score, log loss, skill against the market price and the consensus at posting time, and a 10-bucket calibration curve.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_markets · Private data: post_signal, get_calibration · Public sink: post_signal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_markets · Private data: post_signal, get_calibration · Public sink: post_signal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
